about: Laxmi Construction Company was established as a partnership firm by late Mr. Arjanbhai Dau and Mr. Arjanbhai Rabari. In December 2017 LCC converted into LCC Projects Private Ltd and is now one of the leading multidisciplinary engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) companies in India, in terms of market share, in the irrigation and water supply projects segment.
